items.title: BlackRock files for bitcoin ETF offering downside protection and upside exposure to IBIT
items.summary: One of the world's largest investment managers, BlackRock has filed for another bitcoin fund, marking its third tied to the asset.

items.title: Strive buys $335M in Bitcoin, boosting holdings to 36,818 BTC
items.summary: The Bitcoin treasury company added another 1,223 BTC after an earlier purchase pushed it past MARA Holdings, while continuing to expand its reserves through equity financing.

items.title: Strive scoops up another 1,223 bitcoin for $100 million as total holdings reach 36,818 BTC
items.summary: Strive paid approximately $81,734 on average per bitcoin, adding to the 2,822 BTC it had acquired earlier last week.

items.title: Bitmine adds 12,535 ETH as treasury reaches 6.04 million tokens
items.summary: Bitmine bought 12,535 ETH last week, lifting its treasury to 6.04 million tokens and total investment holdings to $15.1 billion.
